scope: Bell-state deterministic evaluation receipt verification example.

artifacts.artifact_role: Preserved probabilistic output submitted for deterministic downstream evaluation.
verifiable_claims: Artifact content matches declared input hash
Referenced distribution fields are available to the evaluator
non_verifiable_claims: The upstream source system was deterministic
The upstream source system was truthful or complete

artifacts.artifact_role: Defines deterministic evaluation rule and allowed downstream decisions.
verifiable_claims: Contract content matches declared contract hash
Referenced rule can be replayed by the verifier if the operator is supported
non_verifiable_claims: The contract is domain-sufficient for all real-world use
The threshold is scientifically or commercially optimal

artifacts.artifact_role: Defines receipt, audit, and failure behavior for the deterministic evaluator.
verifiable_claims: Policy content matches declared policy hash
Receipt-required behavior is visible in the preserved receipt artifact
non_verifiable_claims: The policy satisfies all external regulatory requirements

artifacts.artifact_role: Records the decision claimed by the deterministic evaluator.
verifiable_claims: Receipt status matches recomputed deterministic decision
Receipt output hash matches receipt content when present
non_verifiable_claims: The upstream source generated the input honestly
The decision is safe for production deployment

artifacts.artifact_role: Records whether the receipt survived deterministic verification.
verifiable_claims: Report content can be canonically hashed
Report identifies the checked receipt and artifacts
Report records PASS/FAIL/UNSUPPORTED style verification evidence
non_verifiable_claims: The verifier is the only possible valid verifier
No other external review is required

boundaries.handoff_claim: The preserved input artifact contains the fields required by the decision contract.
boundaries.verification_method: Canonical hash comparison and deterministic field lookup.

boundaries.handoff_claim: The receipt was produced under the referenced contract and policy.
boundaries.verification_method: Recompute deterministic outcome and compare receipt fields, artifact hashes, threshold, computed value, and evaluator identity.

boundaries.handoff_claim: The receipt was checked against preserved artifacts and replayed deterministic evidence.
boundaries.verification_method: Generate structured Verification Report with checked artifacts, checked fields, mismatches, recomputed decision, and report hash.

notes: Governance artifacts declare claims. Verification artifacts test only claims supported by preserved evidence and deterministic replay.
A valid receipt does not prove that the upstream source was deterministic, truthful, safe, or complete.
